description: This source file implements network interface enumeration and attribute retrieval for different platforms (macOS, Android, Linux). It includes functions to convert system network interface data into a project-specific format, with platform-specific classes and methods for obtaining IP attributes and interface types.

classes.name: IPAttributesGetterMac
classes.description: Platform-specific class for retrieving IP address attributes and interface types on macOS using ioctl calls.

methods.name: IPAttributesGetterMac
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a socket for ioctl operations.

methods.name: ~IPAttributesGetterMac
methods.description: Destructor that closes the socket if initialized.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the socket for ioctl operations has been successfully initialized.

methods.name: GetAddressAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves IP address attributes for a given interface using ioctl.

methods.name: GetNetworkInterfaceType
methods.description: Determines the network interface type (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, etc.) on macOS.
